newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Ahmsa to invest $222 mln in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Ahmsa to invest $222 mln in 1997.

text.p: Mexican steel giant Altos Hornos de Mexico (Ahmsa) said Tuesday its 1997 investments will total $222 million and will go towards improving processes and overall efficiency.
In a statement, the Monclova-based company said its plans included investments in galvanised sheet steel painting, the overhaul of one of its coking plants and of a coal injection plant.

"The investments defined by Ahmsa will increase the range of products offered to clients, boost value-added products, strengthen profitability, and reduce raw material costs," Ahmsa said in a statement.
An Ahmsa director told Reuters the investments would be financed through internal company funds.
"The investments will not boost installed capacity; they will boost valued added, improve efficiency and free up bottle necks," he said.
